description:
Programme Overview

The University Scholarship Potsdam (USP) is the University of Potsdam's version of the national Germany Scholarship (Deutschlandstipendium) programme. It provides €300 per month for at least one year (€150 from private sponsors plus €150 matched by the Federal Government = €3,600/year per scholar).

Financial Coverage

  • €300/month for at least one year.
  • Income-independent; combinable with BAföG.
  • Paid during subject-related stays abroad.
  • No repayment required.
  • Approximately 85 scholarships awarded per year for Winter Semester 2025/26 + Summer Semester 2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Enrolled at University of Potsdam or incoming first-year students.
  • Excellent academic achievements.
  • Volunteer/social engagement and/or overcoming circumstances that aggravated educational biography.
  • Must not exceed standard period of study during funding.
  • International students: grade average must be converted to German grading system (via uni-assist) and uploaded; otherwise application cannot be processed.

Key Dates (2026/27 cycle as template)

MilestoneDate
Online application phase1-22 July 2026
Selection of scholarship holdersJuly-September
Award notificationsFrom early October
Scholarship ceremony13 November 2026

Next Cycle

Expected 1-22 July 2027. Note: July 1 is the opening date, not the deadline.

Application Process

  1. Enrol or gain admission at University of Potsdam first.
  2. Convert transcripts via uni-assist (mandatory for international applicants).
  3. Prepare evidence of volunteering/social engagement.
  4. Apply online 1-22 July 2027.

Separate Foundation Scholarships

The University also lists talent-support foundations (Cusanuswerk, political foundations, etc.) with separate applications and language requirements (B2/C1 German). PhD candidates use separate university PhD scholarships.

Official Links

  • USP/Germany Scholarship: https://www.uni-potsdam.de/en/universitaetsstipendium/germanyscholarship
  • How to apply: https://www.uni-potsdam.de/en/universitaetsstipendium/information-for-students
  • All scholarship programmes: https://www.uni-potsdam.de/en/studium/studying/financing-funding-housing/scholarship-programs

Important Notes

  • Partially funded: €300/month supplements living costs; not a full ride.
  • Tuition at UP is largely fee-free (only semester contribution).
  • Doctoral candidates use separate schemes, not USP.
  • Apply only via official UP portal.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 22 July 2027 (Expected). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
